name: source-file-links
goal: Source lists actual files with revision-pinned GitHub links and a modal button for each file

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Source tab must list concrete files only, linking each to the selected GitHub commit and opening that file in the shared modal. Feature specification updated.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing Reports entity-preview-source and Desktop entity-source-code scenarios asserted one entity action and accepted metadata. Strengthened those scenarios and snapshot fixtures with per-file links, encoded paths, directory ownership and direct second-file opening.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Final test-only checkpoint 05a9d9e3068194f3d4d244081e6b8a876ec1e746 fails with missing per-file Source rows and repository metadata. Immutable record b8bf3157eba32bef5566f3f626a4e2e0eb2ce79f3d59ce7c17be8e94d02e316a. Earlier fixture and audit checkpoints are superseded; expectations remain intact.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared SourceFileList replaces ownership metadata. Each row links to the selected GitHub commit and opens its file first; Reports archives and the Desktop bridge preserve lazy reads and focus.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged tests, fixtures, command and environment pass at 69a37f29489a7c82fdd7fd19aea0fdd74726d1b5. Immutable green 6dba2a73c0e25b00673e00a42e43502439e12075910dd0744e638b312cc913bd; final red b8bf3157eba32bef5566f3f626a4e2e0eb2ce79f3d59ce7c17be8e94d02e316a.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
